title: GenerationRequested
description: A piece of content somebody wants written. What to write is in the job, not in the event. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

job_id.description: The job holding the template, the sources and everything else the generation needs.
